## Hinge question · How many increments? {#ss3-hinge .ap-lesson .sequence-hinge .ap-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge numeric-choices">
<p class="hinge-question">An arithmetic sequence has <span data-math="a_4=11">a₄ = 11</span> and common difference <span data-math="3">3</span>. What is <span data-math="a_{10}">a₁₀</span>?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices">
<button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span data-math="26">26</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span data-math="29">29</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span data-math="38">38</span></button>
<button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span data-math="41">41</span></button>
</div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>2.</strong> There are six increments from term 4 to term 10.<br><span data-math="a_{10}=a_4+(10-4)d=11+6(3)=29">a₁₀ = a₄ + (10 − 4)d = 11 + 6(3) = 29</span>.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes

Default 60 seconds. Use fist-on-chest then simultaneous 1–4 fingers on the teacher’s verbal cue. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer. Reveal after collecting responses.
1: 26 adds only five increments, counting intermediate terms instead of transitions.
2 (correct): 29 adds six increments: 10−4=6.
3: 38 treats the given fourth term as the first term and adds nine increments.
4: 41 adds ten increments to the given value, ignoring both its index and the n−1 adjustment.
Ready: invite a second method, finding a=11−3(3)=2 and then a_10=2+9(3)=29.
Divided: write indices 4,5,…,10 and count transitions, then re-poll.
Reteach: advance one term at a time from a_4=11 before compressing six additions to 6d.

:::
